name: Zoom
review:
Zoom is a 6x4 retro fruit slot with 64 ways. Landing a Zoom symbol triggers a respin that expands into a special feature.

Thunderkick rates it Low volatility, with a 1,500x cap and a 96.2% RTP.

Zoom symbols trigger respins that open up a special feature, giving a simple fruit grid a modern twist. Low volatility keeps sessions calm.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
